# Data Source: tfe_current_user

Get the current user associated with the API token. When authenticated with a team or organization token, HCP Terraform returns a synthetic service user rather than a real user account, so attributes like `email` and `username` will not reflect a real person.

## Example Usage

```java
import software.constructs.*;
import com.hashicorp.cdktf.*;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import gen.providers.tfe.dataTfeCurrentUser.*;
public class MyConvertedCode extends TerraformStack {
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, String name) {
        super(scope, name);
        DataTfeCurrentUser dataTfeCurrentUserCurrent =
        new DataTfeCurrentUser(this, "current", new DataTfeCurrentUserConfig());
        TerraformOutput.Builder.create(this, "email")
                .value(dataTfeCurrentUserCurrent.getEmail())
                .build();
    }
}
```

```java
import software.constructs.*;
import com.hashicorp.cdktf.*;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
import gen.providers.tfe.dataTfeCurrentUser.*;
import gen.providers.tfe.organizationMembership.*;
public class MyConvertedCode extends TerraformStack {
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, String name) {
        super(scope, name);
        DataTfeCurrentUser dataTfeCurrentUserCurrent =
        new DataTfeCurrentUser(this, "current", new DataTfeCurrentUserConfig());
        new OrganizationMembership(this, "owner", new OrganizationMembershipConfig()
                .email(Token.asString(dataTfeCurrentUserCurrent.getEmail()))
                .organization("my-org")
                );
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) The email address of the current user.
- `id` (String) The ID for the user.
- `isServiceAccount` (Boolean) Whether the current user is a service account.
- `username` (String) The username of the current user.
